shortDescription: Coinglass data shows that if ETH falls below $2,363, cumulative long liquidations across major centralized exchanges could reach $584 million. According to ChainCatcher, if ETH rises above $2,592, cumulative short liquidations across major centralized exchanges could reach $415 million.
